content: Obesity is a recognized risk factor for the development of several cancers, including breast, colon, and gynecological carcinomas. Recent research has clarified that obesity not only correlates with carcinogenesis but also influences the prognosis of cancer patients. For instance, obesity has been linked to a poor prognosis in patients with breast and colon cancers. Conversely, a favorable prognosis has been observed in obese patients with gastric or renal cancers.
